binaries.name: uac
binaries.why: Collect from a live Unix-like host — Linux, macOS, ESXi, BSD, Solaris — driven by YAML artefact definitions, with no agent and no dependencies.

binaries.name: velociraptor
binaries.why: Build an offline collector with a chosen artefact set baked in, and read the container it produces. AGPL-3.0, the same licence as this harness.

binaries.name: CyLR
binaries.why: Pull NTFS artefacts off a live Windows host through the raw handle, including files that are locked.
